items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I was talking to Thelma Carpenter

ctx.x: "Oo, I got fired!" I was talking to Thelma Carpenter and somebody /said, "Where are you working?" "I don't know, I got fired." Thelma said, "You shouldn't do that." in New York. You wouldn't get another job." I said, "I'd rather be out." I was up there playing real commercial music and skipping notes on classical - the worse you played it the better you'd go over - and the worst commercial music. I was hanging out on 52nd Street where Billie Holiday was. I heard this music and it was terrific. Barney did hire me…
When you say you seem to have been an inspiration to all these people that came up here, in what way were you an inspiration. Was it that you gave them ideas?
